Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
 We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
 Here’s what this particular role covers.
 🛠️ About our AI Platform Team 
 Our AI Platform teams build the foundations that enable Wayve’s machine learning engineers and researchers to train, evaluate and deploy models at scale. Within the AI Libraries team, you’ll create high-quality platforms, tools and reusable abstractions that support thousands of GPUs and help accelerate the development of our autonomous-driving technology.
   🧠 Your day-to-day 
 You’ll work closely with machine learning teams to understand their workflows and turn complex requirements into stable, scalable and intuitive software. You’ll spend much of your time designing and writing Python, leading projects from discovery through delivery, improving engineering standards and supporting users as they push the scale and performance of their models.
 🧩 What you’ll be working on 
 You’ll build modular libraries for areas such as multimodal data loading, distributed training and inference, checkpointing and observability. You’ll improve the reliability, performance and developer experience of systems used across Wayve, helping teams train models efficiently on large GPU clusters and work with camera, radar, lidar and other data sources.
   🙌 You should apply if 
 You have deep Python expertise and a proven track record of leading the design, delivery and long-term evolution of high-quality software systems at scale. You can turn complex requirements across ML teams into stable, reusable libraries and clear APIs, set technical direction, and raise the bar for software architecture, testing and observability. You remain hands-on while guiding other engineers and driving projects end to end, from shaping requirements through to adoption and maintenance. Experience with concurrent, parallel or distributed computing is important; familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow and cloud environments—ideally Azure—is highly valuable. This is a Staff-level software and platform engineering role, not an ML modelling position.
   🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.
   More about Wayve: 
 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.
 Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.
   How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: 
 Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.
   🔍 The Interview Process: 
 Our process is clear and respectful of your time:
 Recruiter screen 
 Competency Interviews 
 Deep-dive technical interviews 
 Final interview 
 We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.
   What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 
 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more
 A quick, honest note before you apply.
 Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.
 If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.
At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.
 For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve 
DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

items.jobTitle: Global Trainee Program - Outperformer Software Business Track (HILTI)
items.jobDescription:
4PS is part of the Hilti Group , which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via Hilti Careerpage 
 Construction technology is being reinvented. Be part of it.
 Construction is one of the world's largest industries, and one of its least digitized. That is changing fast. At Hilti, we are not only developing software products - we are building and growing digital businesses around them. Hilti is at the centre of that shift, with a growing portfolio of software products that connect jobsites, offices, teams, and tools across the entire construction lifecycle. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.
The Software & Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.
 What You'll do
 The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.
The program places you inside one of two business units:
Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.
Fastening & Protection Solutions: Where design & engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.
For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:
 ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.
 ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.
 ​For the Fastening & Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:
 ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.
 ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each, involving international projects that broaden your business perspective and global exposure.
 You will have a dedicated senior mentor from the start, direct exposure to executive leadership, and a peer cohort of Global Trainees across all Hilti business tracks globally.
 What You’ll Bring
 You are close to graduating or have recently completed a Master's degree - your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. What matters more than your degree subject is the combination of traits below:

Über Holidu 
 Holidu ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen für Ferienvermietung weltweit. Unser Ziel: Ferienunterkünfte sollen sich sorgenfrei buchen und vermieten lassen und dabei einfach Freude machen. Dafür helfen wir Gastgeber*innen, mit weniger Aufwand mehr Buchungen zu erzielen, und Gästen, genau die Ferienunterkunft zu finden, in der sie sich rundum wohlfühlen. Bei uns arbeiten rund 700 Kolleg*innen aus über 60 Nationen. Uns verbinden die Leidenschaft für Technologie, der Anspruch, jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu werden, und der Antrieb, mehr als 40.000 Gastgeber*innen und 4 Millionen Gästen im Jahr das bestmögliche Erlebnis zu bieten.
 Dein Team 
 Unser Finance-Team kümmert sich um die Zahlen hinter der schnell wachsenden Reiseplattform. In der Buchhaltung sind wir rund 15 Kolleg*innen und verantworten aktuell mehr als zehn Gesellschaften im In- und Ausland, Tendenz steigend. Bei uns lernst du das Handwerk der Buchhaltung von erfahrenen Kolleg*innen von Grund auf und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung; in welche Richtung, das gestaltest du mit deinen Stärken und Interessen. Weil wir wirklich als Team arbeiten, kommt der Spaß dabei nicht zu kurz, im Alltag wie bei unseren Teamevents.
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Du übernimmst Aufgaben der Finanzbuchhaltung, insbesondere in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung im operativen Tagesgeschäft: du bearbeitest unser Buchhaltungspostfach, erfasst und verbuchst Rechnungen, bereitest Zahlläufe vor, unterstützt bei der laufenden Kontenabstimmung und -pflege und klärst kleinere Differenzen zunehmend selbstständig.
 Du wirkst bei unseren Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen mit.
 Du unterstützt bei Projekten zum Beispiel bei der Prozessoptimierung in der Buchhaltung
 Du hilfst mit, unsere Buchhaltung Schritt für Schritt schlauer zu machen, zum Beispiel mit Excel oder KI.
 Du entwickelst dich Schritt für Schritt weiter und gestaltest deine Zukunft bei uns aktiv mit.
   Dein Profil 
 Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, z. B. als Steuerfachangestellte*r, oder ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzbuchhaltung / Rechnungswesen.
 Du hast bereits erste Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung gesammelt, zum Beispiel im Rahmen deiner Ausbildung, eines Praktikums oder einer Werkstudententätigkeit.
 Du bringst gute Kenntnisse in der Rechnungslegung mit und kennst die Grundlagen der Buchhaltung; in neue Themen arbeitest du dich mit Freude ein.
 Du arbeitest sicher mit Excel
 Kenntnisse von Buchhaltungssystemen wie SAP sind von Vorteil
 Du bist offen für den Einsatz von KI und hast Freude daran, wiederkehrende Aufgaben schlauer zu lösen.
 Du arbeitest verlässlich, genau und strukturiert, bringst analytisches Denken mit und schaust gerne über den Tellerrand, um bestehende Prozesse zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern.
 Du hast Spaß an der Arbeit in einem dynamischen, schnellen Umfeld und bringst Eigenmotivation und Einsatzbereitschaft mit, um wirklich etwas zu bewegen.
 Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mindestens C1 Level) und gut Englisch.
   Was wir sonst noch bieten 
 Lernen: Wachse in einer Arbeitskultur, die von Neugier und offenem Feedback lebt. Lerne von unseren herausragenden Kolleg*innen, arbeite disziplinübergreifend zusammen und profitiere von Mentoring und persönlichen Lernbudgets – mit einem besonderen Fokus auf KI.
 Flexibilität: Genieße die Vorteile eines hybriden Arbeitsmodells mit mindestens 50% Bürozeit für persönliche Zusammenarbeit und arbeite bis zu 8 Wochen im Jahr von anderen inspirierenden Orten aus. Bleibe durch regelmäßige Veranstaltungen und Meetups über unsere fast 30 Büros hinweg verbunden.
 Tolle Leute: Werde Teil eines Teams aus smarten, motivierten und internationalen Kolleg*innen, die sich gegenseitig fordern und unterstützen. Wir feiern Erfolge und halten unsere Kultur unterhaltsam, ehrgeizig und menschlich. Unsere Kunden sind Gäste und Gastgeber – Menschen, mit denen sich jeder identifizieren kann – genau das macht unsere Arbeit bedeutungsvoll und inspirierend.
 Impact: Gestalte die Zukunft des Reisens mit Produkten, die von Millionen Gästen und Tausenden Gastgebern genutzt werden. Bei Holidu werden aus Ideen echte Produkte, Daten bestimmen unsere Entscheidungen und durch ständige Verbesserung lernen wir schneller. Deine Arbeit hat Bedeutung – und du wirst den Unterschied direkt sehen.
 Technologie: Arbeite in einem modernen Tech-Umfeld. Erlebe das Tempo eines Scale-ups kombiniert mit der Stabilität eines bewährten Geschäftsmodells, das dir ermöglicht, kontinuierlich Neues zu entwickeln, zu testen und zu optimieren.

Contexte
Alfeor est un groupe de PME industrielles françaises (nucléaire, défense). Le groupe déploie l’IA dans toutes ses filiales, avec des contraintes fortes de sécurité et de souveraineté des données. Vous rejoignez la holding et travaillez directement avec la direction et les équipes terrain. Déplacements fréquents sur les sites des filiales, 2 à 3 jours par semaine.
Missions
 Identifier et prioriser les cas d’usage IA avec les équipes des filiales (méthodes, achats, qualité, commerce, direction).
 Construire des outils et les mettre en service : connexion aux ERP et CRM, automatisation de tâches répétitives, agents sur de la documentation technique volumineuse.
 Administrer l’infrastructure IA du groupe (serveurs Linux, conteneurs, API d’inférence).
 Appliquer les règles de sécurité et de gouvernance des données dans un environnement sensible.
 Former et accompagner les utilisateurs (ateliers, permanences, supports).
Exemples de projets
 Extraction et analyse de données ERP pour aider les équipes commerciales.
 Assistant de recherche dans des normes techniques de plusieurs milliers de pages.
 Transcription et comptes rendus automatiques de réunions.
 Veille automatisée sur des entreprises cibles.
 Amélioration de process internes (suivi des commandes, contrôle qualité).
Profil
 École d’ingénieurs, de commerce ou université, avec un fort profil technique.
 Python, Rust, SQL, API, Docker, Linux. Une expérience avec des LLM ou des agents est un plus.
 Bases solides en cybersécurité (réseaux, gestion des accès, protection des données).
 Polyvalent : à l’aise sur un sujet technique comme dans un atelier avec un opérateur, une réunion avec la direction ou animer une séance de formation.
 Autonome, avec un esprit entrepreneurial. Vous avancez sans attendre qu’on vous dise quoi faire.
 Capacité à expliquer des sujets techniques à des personnes non techniques.
Ce que nous offrons
 Une grande autonomie et un impact direct sur des entreprises industrielles réelles.
 Des sujets variés, dans des secteurs peu exposés à l’IA aujourd’hui.
 Fort impact et la possibilité de mener de bout en bout des projets.
 Télétravail possible de manière occasionnelle.
 Offre de CDI selon performance

 Tasks

 Analysis of international commercial and regulatory healthcare topics regarding market entry and market expansion

 Requirements

Software Engineer, Connected Vehicle Platform
 Rivian
 A joint venture between Rivian and Volkswagen Group focused on developing software-defined vehicle technology including operating systems, zonal controllers, cloud and connectivity solutions for electric vehicles.
 Rivian is the employer — EngRadar is a job radar, not a recruiter. We track this posting from their own careers page and send you straight there; we never handle applications or CVs.
Remote Berlin Full-time Posted today automotiveevconnectivity
Apply directly →
 About Us
 Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.
The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.
 Role Summary
 The Berlin team is looking for a Software Engineer - Connected Vehicle Platform, to design, build, and operate software connecting vehicle systems with infotainment, cloud, and mobile ecosystems. You will bridge low-level communication paths and high-level vehicle interfaces, developing reusable platform capabilities while supporting brand-specific configurations.
This role combines software development, systems integration, troubleshooting, and developer enablement. You will help turn vehicle signals and hardware capabilities into dependable services, libraries, gateway behaviors, and APIs that partner engineers can discover, integrate, test, and use successfully. The role is well suited to a developer who enjoys working across system boundaries and taking software from design through production support.
This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite
 Responsibilities
 Design, develop, test, and maintain communication services, client libraries, gateway and routing components, and deployment configurations; implement message publication and subscription, request/reply interactions, service discovery, signal routing, gateway translation, and reliable failure handling.
 Contribute to software components written in C++, Rust, Go, Kotlin, or other languages used across vehicle and cloud platform layers; evolve interface contracts, schemas, configuration models, and generated APIs while preserving compatibility for existing consumers.
 Decide whether functionality belongs in a reusable platform abstraction, gateway mapping, vehicle service, application, or vehicle- or brand-specific integration; deploy and validate services across vehicle-oriented compute platforms, virtualized embedded environments, simulators, software-in-the-loop systems, benches, and prototype vehicles.
 Investigate issues across vehicle interfaces, gateways, message-passing services, vehicle-model APIs, and consuming applications using logs, traces, packet captures, diagnostics, and test tools; improve reliability, performance, observability, security, deployment automation, and test coverage.
 Support partner developers through integration guidance, examples, troubleshooting, documentation, and technical issue triage; collaborate with hardware, firmware, embedded, cloud, infotainment, security, validation, product, and external partner teams.
 Participate in design reviews, code reviews, incident follow-up, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.
 Qualifications
 Degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience) plus 3+ years developing software in distributed systems, embedded platforms, or middleware; strong C++, Rust, Go, or Kotlin skills across a multi-language platform.
 Experience with messaging, gRPC, event-driven architectures, distributed systems, and designing or using Protobuf contracts (or equivalent), APIs, and schemas.
 Familiarity with CAN/DBC, vehicle gateways, signal integration, and connected devices; physical-input or HMI gateway experience is a plus.
 Ability to deploy and debug on embedded/virtual platforms (Android Automotive, Linux, test benches, simulators) with experience in CI/CD, Docker, or Bazel.
 Knowledge of mutual TLS, auth, telemetry (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry), and end-to-end troubleshooting using logs, traces, and packet captures.
 Strong communication skills to support developer adoption via SDKs and docs; experience with platform abstractions, automotive partners, Clean Architecture, and TDD/DDD.
 Total Rewards
 We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.
Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

The Robotics & Mechatronics Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a  C++ Software Engineer (m/f/d) Platform Infrastructure , who will help build and maintain the C++ platform infrastructure our robot runs on. You will help us ensure it runs reliably and safely once it is out of the lab and in production.
 Responsibilities 
 Platform Development: Develop and maintain modern C++ software components for the robot's Linux-based platform infrastructure.
 Communication & IPC: Build and maintain the IPC and communication interfaces that connect robot applications, backend services, and hardware-facing components.
 Debugging & Diagnostics: Debug concurrency, timing, memory, performance, and system-integration issues across the platform.
 Testing Infrastructure: Build unit, integration, and hardware-oriented test infrastructure for platform components.
 Reliability & Observability: Improve system reliability through better diagnostics, logging, fault handling, and recovery mechanisms.
 Hardware Integration: Test and integrate software on real robotic hardware, working with firmware, control, backend, QA, and DevOps engineers when problems cross those boundaries.
 Essential Skills 
 Background: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience, with initial professional experience building production C++ software, typically up to about three years and excluding internships or working-student positions.
 Modern C++: Hands-on experience writing C++ using modern practices (C++17/C++20), gained through professional work, internships, or substantial project experience.
 Systems Programming: Working understanding of Linux system programming — processes, threads, synchronization, IPC, and sockets — along with asynchronous programming concepts.
 Debugging: Practical debugging experience using tools such as GDB, sanitizers (ASan/TSan/UBSan), or Valgrind, applied to problems that span multiple interacting software or hardware components.
 Testing: Experience writing automated tests with frameworks such as GoogleTest, including meaningful unit and integration test coverage.
 Beneficial Skills 
 Robotics & Industrial Background: Experience with robotics, industrial automation, or embedded systems, including industrial communication protocols such as EtherCAT, CAN, or similar.
 Hardware-in-the-Loop Testing: Experience with hardware-in-the-loop, simulation, fault-injection, or other automated system-testing approaches.
 Embedded Linux: Experience with real-time or performance-sensitive Linux systems, or with the deployment side of embedded Linux.
 Python Tooling: Experience using Python for testing, automation, or developer tooling.
 AI-Assisted Development: Experience using AI-assisted development tools, combined with critically reviewing and validating the generated output.
 What we offer 
 A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors. 
 Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment. 
 Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow. 
 Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth. 
 Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month. 
 Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment 
 About us 
 Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 
 Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 
 Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.
 Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.
We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.
 We want you as a talented AIT EVT & Thermal Engineer to help us in our mission by making sure that ​NYX can be integrated, tested and launched.
 You will be successful in this role if you are able to help us:
 Collect and compile all the requirements/need to tests from different sub-systems owners
 Optimizes and Consolidate a flow of testing based on these needs
 Prepare, execute and manage the EVT (Environment Test) campaign, including integration in the test facility and conduction of the tests on our space vehicles
 Write AIT documentation prior and post integration and test activities
 Manage internal and external stakeholders (propulsion, thermal, thermal protection, avionic & power units) to perform a successful test
 Key Responsibilities: 
 You will manage the entire EVT Campaign, from external facility management to end of testing, including GSE definition and procurement with internal or external suppliers, test procedures writing and execution, supporting in defining the perimeters of other teams and schedule preparation.
 You will manage the mechanical, thermal and EMC/EMI test parts, being the focal point of TEC wrt the external facility.
 You will create a list of procedures detailing the assembly and mechanical setups for integration and tests (in Epsilon3, ODOO, Team Center) - being full responsible of the leading procedure of all tests.
 You will be responsible for the execution of these procedures, and we expect you to interact with other AIT engineers and technicians
 You will be largely involved in the resolutions of anomalies happening during the integration and tests
 You will manage the reports to be done at the end of the operations/tests
 You will give your feedback and report on any blockage or problem during the AIT and will work to propose improvements and fixes
 You will be supporting the Purchase of the equipment (COTS or not) needed to run the test activities (TGSE, MGSE, FGSE)
 You will collect the test requirement from different sub-system owners and Chief engineering team.
 Additional Requirements :
 Versatile: in order to manage several test preparations, and being the TEC interface person among various engineering teams
 Proficient: in following safety standards and maintaining quality control during all assembly and test operations.
 Very good system understanding, thermal and functional qualification
 Qualifications and experience 
 Engineering degree (Master or PhD) in mechanical science or equivalent
 At least 5 years experience in the AIT of aerospace vehicles
 Experience in conducting test campaigns, a plus if an EVT campaign has already been conducted
 Skills and Behaviors 
 Leadership skills
 Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks
 Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done
 Ability to communicate at all levels of the business in English
 Organized and rigorous
 Hands-on approach
 Inventive and problem solver, team spirit
 Able to document all tasks in written form
 Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Vision, Mission, Teamwork, Integrity and Excellence.
 Why you should join us! 
 What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  
 We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 
 We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  
 We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  
 We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.   
All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

 Who we are 
 Royal Ingredients Group located in Alkmaar, part of the Cefetra Group, is a dynamic trading company with locations in the United States, India, China, Dubai, Mexico and Spain. We specialize in the international trade of raw materials/ingredients (starches, sugars and plant proteins) for the food, animal feed and paper industries and operate in more than 100 countries. The company culture is relaxed when possible and businesslike when needed. In an open office environment, we aim for short and direct communication between all departments. We are looking for new talents with a no-nonsense mentality who want to actively contribute to the further growth of the company, with own initiative encouraged.
 The role 
As a Junior Business Data Analyst, you are the link between business and IT. You bring together processes and data to support decision-making. You help the organization to use data structurally, reliably and effectively. You look beyond data alone: you make processes clear, see opportunities for digitization and automation and use data to help departments. You become part of the IT & Data team and work with all departments, including Finance, Trade and Logistics. You translate data into concrete insights and actively contribute to the further professionalization of data-driven work within Royal Ingredients.
 What will you do? 
 Data and insights 
 Analyze operational, commercial and financial data from various sources
 Contribute to data governance, data quality and standardization of definitions and KPIs
 Think along about further development of the data and analytics platform
 Contribute to the development of AI tools to make data more accessible
 Processes and digitization

 Think about digitization and automation of processes
 What do you bring? 
 A completed higher professional education or university degree, for example in Data Science, (Business) Informatics, Econometrics, Business Administration or a similar direction
 Available for 24-32 hours per week
 0-3 years work experience
 Initial experience with data or process improvement, for example via an internship, thesis project or first job
 Basic knowledge of Power BI, knowledge of SQL, Python, ETL processes and modern data platforms (like Microsoft Fabric) is a plus
 Affinity with business processes in a trading or international environment, interest in digitization and automation, and curiosity about how AI can improve your work and processes
 Strong communication skills in Dutch and English, and ability to explain complex analyses clearly
 A proactive, critical and structured work attitude and eagerness to develop yourself

Why Faculty? 
We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here .
 We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.
 Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.
 AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.
     About the team 
   Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions. 
We understand that powerful AI systems bring both transformative opportunities and complex risks and we are proud to partner with Government and the biggest tech organisations in the world to ensure AI is not just transformative but is also secure, trustworthy and safe for all.
Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Developed Vetting (DV) and willing to work on site with our clients from time to time.
   About the role 
   Join us as a Machine Learning Engineer to deliver bespoke, impactful AI solutions for our diverse clients.
   You will be instrumental in bringing machine learning out of the lab and into the real world, contributing to scalable software architecture and defining best practices. Working with clients, and cross-functional teams, you'll ensure technical feasibility and timely delivery of high-quality, production-grade ML systems. 
   What you'll be doing: 
   Building and deploying production-grade ML software, tools, and infrastructure.
 Creating reusable, scalable solutions that accelerate the delivery of ML systems.
 Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, and commercial leads to solve critical client challenges.
 Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions to ensure project feasibility and impact.
 Defining and implementing Faculty’s standards for deploying machine learning at scale.
 Acting as a technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex ML concepts for stakeholders.
 Who we're looking for: 
   You understand the full machine learning lifecycle and have experience operationalising models built with frameworks like Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
 You possess strong Python skills and solid experience in software engineering best practices.
 You bring hands-on experience with cloud platforms and infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture and security.
 You've worked with container and orchestration tools such at Docker & Kubernetes to build and manage applications at scale
 You are comfortable with core ML concepts, including probability, statistics, and common learning techniques.
 You're an excellent communicator, able to guide technical teams and confidently advise non-technical stakeholders.
 You thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy the autonomy to own scope, solve and delivery solutions
   Our Interview Process 
   Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)
 Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes) 
 System Design Interview (90 minutes) 
 Commercial Interview (60 minutes)
 Our Recruitment Ethos 
 We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.
 If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. 
 A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. items.jobTitle: Junior Managers Program (Trainee) - Starte deine Leadership Journey im Bereich IT
items.jobDescription:
Bereit, die IT-Welt zu verändern?  Wir suchen technikbegeisterte Master-Graduates mit Gestaltungswillen, um mit uns im Junior Managers Program die digitale Transformation von Bosch zu gestalten. Wenn du von Daten begeistert bist, strategisch denkst und leidenschaftlich daran interessiert bist, eine herausragende Führungskarriere zu gestalten, möchten wir von dir hören. 
 Über eine intensive Reise von 12-24 Monaten wirst du durch die wichtigsten Bereiche unserer digitalen Organisation in Deutschland und im Ausland rotieren. Deine Mission ist es, ein tiefes Verständnis für unser Geschäft und die entsprechende Digital-Strategie zu gewinnen, während du tiefgehende Expertise in der Vernetzung und Entwicklung digitaler Geschäftsmodelle hinsichtlich weltweiter IT-Infrastruktur, Cloud-Technologien und dem Einsatz von kundenorientierten Plattformen und Software-Lösungen aufbaust. ​Du wirst an hochwirksamen Projekten arbeiten und diese leiten, von erfahrenen Führungskräften betreut werden und praktische Erfahrungen mit den neuesten Technologien sammeln, die unsere Branche bereits neu definieren. ​
 Was Du bei uns lernen und entwickeln wirst: ​ 
 Globale IT- & KI-Strategie mitgestalten: Du lernst, wie die globale IT-Strategie eines Tech-Unternehmens mit den Geschäftszielen verknüpft wird, um datengetriebene Entscheidungen und neue digitale Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen. Du gestaltest aktiv die KI- und IT-Infrastruktur mit, treibst die Automatisierung von Kernprozessen voran und begleitest den weltweiten Auf- und Ausbau zukunftsweisender, KI-gestützter Systeme.
 Cloud- & Software-Infrastruktur optimieren: Du arbeitest an unserer Cloud-Transformations-Roadmap mit, indem du die Migration von Unternehmensanwendungen begleitest und innovative Cloud-Services evaluierst. Mit modernen Tech-Stacks konzipierst du Webservices, Microservice-Architekturen und Daten-Pipelines, die das Rückggrat unserer digitalen Produkte bilden.
 Führungskompetenz im agilen Umfeld aufbauen: Du leitest eigenständig (agile) technische Teilprojekte oder Entwicklungen und wirst dabei von einem persönlichen Mentor auf Managementebene begleitet. Durch die Steuerung komplexer Systemlandschaften und die enge Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams bereitest du dich gezielt auf deine zukünftige Rolle als Führungskraft im Technologieumfeld vor.
Dein akademisches Fundament: Ein sehr guter (Vollzeit-) Master in Informatik, Informationstechnologie, (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, Data Science, Data Analytics, Informationsmanagement, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Physik, Mathematik oder einem verwandten (medien-) technologischen Bereich. Dein Fokus liegt auf Themen wie bspw. Cloudtechnologien, Webservices, IoT, Big Data, KI, Software-Architektur und/oder Data Analytics. Vielleicht hast du bereits einen MBA, PhD oder erste Berufserfahrung erworben. ​
 Deine Begeisterung für digitale Welten: Du bist von Natur aus neugierig und bereit, schnell neue Technologien und Kontexte zu lernen und dich anzupassen. Erste praktische Vorerfahrungen (z. B. durch Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten) in der IT-Beratung, bei IT-Dienstleistern, Software-Herstellern, in der Industrie, Forschung oder in einem agilen Start-up- und Accelerator-Umfeld sind ein großes Plus. ​
 Dein Blick für das große Ganze: Du findest es faszinierend zu verstehen, wie ein globales Unternehmen funktioniert und bist motiviert, Digital-Initiativen mit den Unternehmenszielen zu verbinden. Es fällt dir leicht, komplexe IT-Ökosysteme zu durchdringen, in ganzheitlichen "End-to-End"-Prozessen zu denken und diese mit Business-Domänen wie Logistik, Einkauf, Finance oder HR zu verknüpfen. ​
 Dein Verständnis für Human-centric Leadership: Du lebst die Überzeugung, dass herausragende Ergebnisse nur durch die Befähigung von Menschen entstehen. Mit emotionaler Intelligenz und Empathie schaffst du ein Umfeld, in dem Technologie das menschliche Potenzial entfaltet. Du besitzt ein starkes Service-Mindset sowie eine überzeugende Persönlichkeit und kannst sowohl mit hochspezialisierten IT-Experten als auch mit nicht-technischen Stakeholdern erfolgreich auf Augenhöhe kommunizieren.​
 Du denkst strategisch und gestaltest die Zukunft: Du erkennst das große Ganze, leitest daraus als Führungspersönlichkeit eine klare Vision ab und entwickelst die Roadmap, die uns dorthin bringt. Wertvolle erste Einblicke im Software-, IT-Infrastruktur- oder I(o)T-Umfeld, gern auch in mittelständischen Unternehmen, Start-ups oder in der Leitung erster technischer Projekte konntest du bereits in der Praxis sammeln. Praktische Erfahrung in der Anwendung einer oder mehrerer Programmier- oder Scripting-Sprachen (wie z. B. Java, C, Python, Matlab oder vergleichbaren Sprachen) sowie erste Berührungspunkte mit Cloud-Plattformen, SAP-Systemen oder Enterprise Architecture zeichnen dich ebenfalls aus. ​
 Deine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung: Du setzt in unserem dynamischen Umfeld deine Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen, täglich ein und entwickelst dich so kontinuierlich weiter – ein Growth-Mindset, das wir aktiv fördern. Du besitzt eine ausgeprägte "Digital-First"-Mentalität, verstehst dich als Early Adopter und bringst die Bereitschaft mit, dich flexibel auf neue Methoden wie Scrum, UX, Change Management oder IT-driven Process Optimization einzulassen. ​
 Deine sprachliche Gewandtheit: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Englisch und bringst gute Deutschkenntnisse (B2-Niveau) mit, um dich in unserem internationalen und lokalen Umfeld sicher zu bewegen.
Warum du es lieben wirst, Teil unserer Community zu sein​ 
Wir sind tief in das Wachstum unserer Teammitglieder investiert. Wir haben eine Umgebung geschaffen, in der du unterstützt, geschätzt und befähigt wirst, deine beste Arbeit zu leisten.
 Mentoring & Sponsoring: Ein Mentor aus der Führungsebene begleitet dich auf deinem Weg, fördert aktiv deine Entwicklung und öffnet dir Türen für deine nächsten Karriereschritte bei uns.​
 Eine Kultur der Zugehörigkeit: Vom ersten Tag an wirst du Teil einer globalen Community von Trainees aus verschiedenen Hintergründen und Standorten. Baue authentische Verbindungen über formale Projekte hinaus durch virtuelle Treffen, lokale Meetups oder unsere (globalen) Trainee-Gipfel.​
 Flexibles & hybrides Arbeiten: Wir vertrauen dir, deine Arbeit so zu managen, dass sie zu deinem Leben passt, mit einem flexiblen Startdatum und einem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag. Wir bieten ein hybrides Modell, das Büro- und Remote-Zusammenarbeit kombiniert. ​
 Kontinuierliches Lernen: Profitiere von 4-6 Rotationen in verschiedenen IT und anderen Geschäftsbereichen, einschließlich einer Rotation im Ausland mit einem großzügigen Budget für berufliche Entwicklung, einschließlich Kursen, Zertifizierungen und Konferenzen.
 Bist du bereit, mit uns die Zukunft des IT zu gestalten? Bewirb dich jetzt und sag uns, warum du der perfekte Kandidat bist, um die digitale Revolution zu leiten.
 Du hast Fragen zum Bewerbungsprozess? 
Claudia Mertens-Baaij (Personalabteilung)
Telefon: 0711 811 7200
 Unser Bewerbungsprozess für das Junior Managers Program umfasst mehrere Schritte:
Ein telefonisches Interview, ein Assessment Center und ein finales Interview.

Chemical Engineer
 We are looking for a Chemical Engineer to develop and improve the propellants and laboratory capability behind our solid rocket propulsion systems. You will combine practical laboratory work with engineering judgement, working on formulation, preparation, characterisation, incoming-material inspection, and the scale-up of propellant solutions from laboratory experiments to propulsion hardware.
 About us
 We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.
We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket. 
We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. 
To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.
 Key responsibilities
 Develop, formulate, prepare, and improve solid propellants for different propulsion requirements.
 Plan and conduct laboratory experiments, characterise materials, and document results clearly.
 Work with propulsion engineers to connect formulation, processing, material properties, and motor performance.
 Support incoming-goods inspection, supplier engagement, and the evaluation of specialist chemicals and raw materials.
 Investigate unexpected results, non-conformances, processing issues, and material compatibility questions.
 Improve laboratory procedures, equipment capability, data quality, safety, and the scale-up of successful formulations.
 What we are looking for
 A degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, polymer science, energetic materials, or a related field.
 Hands-on laboratory or process-development experience for solid propellants.
 Strong understanding of chemistry, materials behaviour, experimental design, and laboratory safety.
 A careful and methodical approach to traceability, measurement quality, process control, and documentation.
 Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to investigate unexpected results.
 The ability to work collaboratively with propulsion, test, manufacturing, quality, and supplier teams.
 Desirable experience
 Solid rocket propellants, binders, oxidisers, metallic fuels, catalysts, or energetic materials.
 Propellant characterisation, burn-rate measurement, thermal analysis, rheology, mechanical testing, ageing, or compatibility.
 Scaling a formulation or laboratory process toward repeatable production.
 Incoming-material inspection, chemical quality control, supplier qualification, or non-conformance investigation.
 Hazardous chemicals, explosives, or regulated laboratory processes.
 Laboratory data systems, statistical analysis, or Python-based data processing.
 Benefits and important information: 
 We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent. 
 Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success. 
 Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.
 Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday
 Free access to shared company housing
 Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week. 
 We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger. 
Please submit applications in English

items.jobDescription:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 
 An overview of this role 
 As a Threat Research Engineer, you’ll take ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. This is a full-stack role, with AI central to how we work. You’ll build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster.
 What you’ll do 
 Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.
 Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.
 Analyze software supply chain incidents and events.
 Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.
 Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.
 Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.
 Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.
 Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it.
 What you’ll bring 
 Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them.
 Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model APIs or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent SDKs.
 Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery, and maintainable code.
 Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.
 Understanding of how package ecosystems work and how software supply chain attacks happen.
 Ability to map possible attack vectors, name trade-offs, and make data-driven decisions, balancing quality and speed with customer outcomes in mind while keeping up with security and AI industry trends.
 Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience.
 Helpful, but not required: published vulnerability findings; security research on AI agents, large language model applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; Google Cloud Platform experience; or infrastructure as code experience with Terraform or OpenTofu.
 You don’t need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing engines. A high-level understanding is enough.
 About the team 
 The Threat Research group researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab’s dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. Recent work includes the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent. You can read more on the Security Labs blog .
 The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the EU, applicable in the specified country or countries only. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location and having regard to any applicable collective agreements. The base salary range does not include bonuses, equity, or benefits. 
 Poland base salary range: 272,000 - 408,000 PLN 
 How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees 
 Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being 
 Flexible Paid Time Off  
 Team Member Resource Groups 
 Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan 
 Growth and Development Fund 
 Parental Leave  
 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
 Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  
 Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
 GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also  GitLab’s EEO Policy  and  EEO is the Law . If you have a disability or special need that requires  accommodation , please let us know during the  recruiting process .

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.
 As a Cloud Engineer, you will operate and support the cloud platforms that power The Exploration Company’s engineering, operations, and data workloads in France. You will design, deploy, and maintain infrastructure on AWS and SecNumCloud-qualified cloud services so teams can work securely and reliably across both environments. This hands-on, high-ownership role sits at the intersection of aerospace and modern cloud engineering, with a strong focus on security, sovereignty, and compliance requirements.
 You will work on-site in France and collaborate closely with engineering teams to translate their needs into resilient, secure, and well-documented infrastructure.
 Key Responsibilities
 Design, deploy, and operate cloud infrastructure on AWS and SecNumCloud-qualified cloud environments, including managed Kubernetes, compute, networking, storage, and managed database services.
 Define and maintain a consistent architecture across AWS and SecNumCloud, including identity, networking, and secrets management, to keep environments comparable and portable where needed.
 Build and maintain infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) so all environments are reproducible and version-controlled.
 Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines that automate infrastructure and application builds, testing, and deployment.
 Manage container platforms and orchestration, including Kubernetes cluster upgrades, networking, RBAC, and workload scheduling.
 Set up and maintain observability (metrics, logging, alerting) to detect and resolve issues before they affect engineering or operations.
 Enforce security and compliance best practices, including IAM policies, network segmentation, encryption at rest and in transit, key management, and vulnerability patching.
 Support audits and compliance evidence collection for SecNumCloud and other applicable frameworks.
 Define backup, retention, and disaster recovery strategies for critical data and services.
 Collaborate with engineering teams to understand their requirements and deliver reliable infrastructure solutions.
 What we would love to see from you
 3+ years of experience in a cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering role.
 Deep hands-on experience with AWS or GCP, including compute, networking, storage, and managed database services.
 Solid experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Terragrunt) and version control workflows.
 Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent).
 Strong understanding of networking concepts: VPCs, subnets, security groups, load balancers, DNS, and VPNs.
 Working knowledge of containers and orchestration, ideally Kubernetes.
 Experience with observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, or OpenTelemetry.
 Willingness to learn sovereign and high-assurance cloud security requirements, and to apply them to cloud environments. Prior exposure is a plus but not required.
 A security-first mindset with practical knowledge of IAM, secrets management, encryption, and compliance frameworks.
 Fluent English. Working knowledge of French is not required but is considered an advantage.
 Ability to work effectively in a multilingual team.
 Nice to have
 Experience in the aerospace, defense, or mission-critical systems domain.
 Experience with multi-region or disaster recovery architectures.
 Experience with hybrid or multi-cloud architectures across AWS and sovereign cloud providers.
 AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer - Professional) or equivalent.
 Exposure to ISO 27001, FedRAMP, or other security certification environments.
 Why you should join us! 
 What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  
 We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 
 We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  
 We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  
 We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.   
All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible. 
If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

About The Company
 Our client is an international leader in satellite communications, delivering connectivity solutions to customers around the world. To strengthen its R&D team in Switzerland, it is looking for a Payload Systems Test Engineer who thinks big, acts with confidence and enjoys working in an inclusive, multidisciplinary environment. 
 The role As a Payload Systems Test Engineer, you will focus on cutting-edge technology for innovative satcom architectures. You understand complex systems which include communication chains, HW/SW as well as optomechanical subsystems, lasers, control loops, mechatronics and the related challenges when targeting the space environment. 
 You enjoy the R&D framework, ranging from (1) the meticulous system integration to (2) the execution of extensive test campaigns in the cleanroom for calibration and optimization, and (3) the consolidation of space-qualified third-party software to drive the overall system. You are passionate about continuous improvement and you feel at ease in a multidisciplinary and international environment, being the one with first hands on the core of the system. 
 Responsabilities
 - Technical responsible for both core system and cleanroom throughout the test campaigns 
 - Technical lead on tests and experiments (test plans, test executions and test reports, from requirements to the compliance matrix) 
 - Point of contact for the high-level SW architecture and responsible for limited SW implementations 
 - Support on both formal and informal reviews 
 - Support on proof-of-concepts 
 - Assist on both system integration and maintenance in the cleanroom 
 Requirements
 - MS/PhD in Engineering (Mechatronics, Microtechnology, Photonics, Electronics, Optoelectronics, Optomechanics, Automation, etc.) 
 - Experience in or interest for the following areas: - Satcom and payload architectures - Lasers and optomechanics - Mechatronics, HW, SW - Python - Test activities in cleanroom - Instrumentation and automation - Low-noise and low-vibration environments 
 - Prior working experience in industry is a plus 
 - Swiss or EU (27) citizenship 
 - Fluent English

About hyperexponential (hx) 
 At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.
 Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.
 Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.
 What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.
 What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.
 If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.
 How we work 
 We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder , and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.
 We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods , usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.
 We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.
 Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.
 A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.
 The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 4 , that looks like this:
   What you'll be doing 
 Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.
 Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.
 Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.
 Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.
 Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.
 Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.
 What you'll need to have done 
 Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.
 Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.
 Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.
 Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.
 Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.
 Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.
 Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.
 At Level 4 we'll also look for 
 Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team.
 Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on.
 Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated.
   You’re unlikely to thrive here if 
 You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.
 You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.
 You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.
 If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.
   Compensation 
 At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.
 Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.
